_README: EDITABLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Active Investors in Japan feature. Edit this file and re-run `python tools/active_investors/refresh.py --build-only` (or the full refresh) to regenerate the public data under compounders/active-investors/data/. To change the 9 cards on the homepage, set `homepage: true` on exactly the investors you want and give them a `curated_rank` (1 = first card). To add an investor, copy a block and fill in `aliases` (the exact EDINET filer-name strings + EDINET codes EDINET uses — used by the ingester to attribute filings). `ranking_mode` controls card ordering: 'curated' uses curated_rank; 'activity' ranks by qualifying-filing count/recency in the window.

qualifying_rules.new_5pct: Initial large-shareholding report (大量保有報告書); crosses the 5% reporting threshold.
qualifying_rules.increase: Change report (変更報告書) with holding ratio up >= 1.00 percentage point.
qualifying_rules.decrease: Change report (変更報告書) with holding ratio down >= 1.00 percentage point.
qualifying_rules.exclude_below_pp: Sub-1pp amendments are kept in the audit set (filings.json with move_type 'other') but hidden from the public default view unless the filing is a new 5% report or a cessation (drop below 5%).

investors.blurb_en: One of Japan's most prolific large-shareholding filers. Takes long-term 5%+ stakes across hundreds of mid- and small-cap names, often in construction, infrastructure and industrials.
investors.blurb_ja: 日本で最も大量保有報告書の提出が多い主体の一つ。建設・インフラ・素材を中心に、数百の中小型株へ長期の5%超保有を積み上げる。
investors.notes: Slow accumulator: files many sub-1pp amendments. Group-level 変更報告書 frequently cross +/-1pp; per-entity views understate activity.
